title: How Filipino 'cleanfluencers' use their platform to raise environmental awareness
summary: In a video that racked up thousands of views on Tiktok, a pile of discarded medical items, plastic, and other waste greet “cleanfluencer” Gabriel Patiño at a beach in Sablayan, Occidental Mindoro.
